text: Whatever happens, the archive/ directory stays as it is.
Please refrain from editing anything under config/prod.
I'd rather you never run git rebase on shared branches here.
The contracts folder is legally sensitive, do not remove or rename files in it.
No deleting rows from the users table, period.
From today on, scripts/deploy.sh is mine, leave it.
Never run helm uninstall against any cluster from this repo.
You must not overwrite the translations in locales/.
Check with me before touching anything in the auth module.
Don't ever wipe the cache/ dir, it takes hours to rebuild.
Could you remove the archive/ folder? It's stale.
Never use var, prefer const and let.
Don't run the full test suite, just the unit tests this time.
Please don't add comments to every line.
Is it safe to delete cache/ before the release?
Rename the contracts folder to agreements.
I told you yesterday we never ship on Fridays, so let's wait.
Don't touch the CSS for now, focus on the API bug first.
Leave a note in the PR description about the migration.
Never mind the warnings, merge it.
